title: Try Natural Home Remedies for Acne
summary: Use kitchen ingredients like honey, cinnamon, neem, aloe vera, tea tree oil, or Multani Mitti to treat acne naturally. Always perform a patch test first.
evidence: Honey + Cinnamon Mask... Neem Paste... Aloe Vera Gel... Tea Tree Oil Spot Treatment... Multani Mitti (Fuller's Earth) Mask
steps: Perform a patch test on your skin before applying any remedy.
For a Honey & Cinnamon mask: Mix 1 tsp honey with 1/2 tsp cinnamon, apply to spots for 10-15 minutes, and rinse with lukewarm water.
For Neem paste: Crush neem leaves or mix neem powder with water, apply for 20 minutes, and wash off.
For Aloe Vera: Apply fresh or 100% pure gel as an overnight treatment.
For Tea Tree Oil: Dilute 1 drop with 3-4 drops of carrier oil (coconut or jojoba) and dab on acne.
For Multani Mitti: Mix with rose water, apply once or twice a week to control oil and clear pores.
